currentRetry.summary: The generic test-only pre-Runner handoff failure now reaches the current retry coordinator and is correctly denied as ineligible. A real Native bootstrap-initialization failure fixture is under construction; no retry success is claimed.

helpReviews.rationale: Reviewed the managed sandbox preparation phase change against the English recovery guide. It reuses the existing source-bound workspace callback for qualified non-conversation chat Tasks; available retry actions, original-task recovery, pending Stop and unknown-outcome guidance remain accurate.

Gennemgået den udskudte workspace-forberedelse mod den danske genoprettelsesvejledning. Ændringen bruger den eksisterende kildebundne callback for kvalificerede chatopgaver; vejledningen om oprindelig opgave, viste genforsøg, afventende stop og ukendt resultat er fortsat korrekt.

Reviewed the exact non-conversation sandbox preparation routing against the English deletion guide. Native termination, runtime-file erasure verification, retention and external-provider limits are unchanged; deferred preparation does not turn a request or Memory deletion into proof of completed erasure.

Gennemgået den præcise ændring i chatopgavers forberedelsesfase mod den danske slettevejledning. Native-stop, verificeret filoprydning, opbevaring og begrænsningen for udbyderdata er uændrede; vejledningens kvitteringer og afventende status er fortsat korrekte.
